subject: Service impact on evaluation - request for goodwill credit & trial extension
messages:
From: Anna Bergström <anna@dataforge.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: support@dataforge.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation cluster regression — severe latency 10/17

Hi Priya,

We started our 14-day trial with Redwood yesterday and ran a smoke workload overnight. At ~22:40 UTC on 2026-10-17 our embedding and generation latencies spiked (p50 moved from ~120ms to ~1.8s, and several requests timed out). This caused our ingestion pipeline to back up and delayed a demo today.

We've attached the request traces and a short SLO summary. Can you confirm whether this is a known regression on your side? We rely on being able to test realistic throughput during the trial window — given this impact, we'd like to request a goodwill credit for the affected evaluation period and an extension of the trial by two weeks while you investigate.

We need a response for our CTO and procurement team by EOD PT.

Thanks,
Anna Bergström
Head of Platform
DataForge

Attachments: request-traces-20261017.tar.gz (log stub), sla-summary-17oct.pdf (report stub)
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Anna Bergström <anna@dataforge.ai>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation cluster regression — severe latency 10/17

Hi Anna — thanks for flagging this and sharing traces. I'm very sorry for the disruption. I can confirm our infra team saw a transient scheduling regression in the US-west eval pool that morning; we have a postmortem in progress.

I'll escalate internally for a one-time goodwill credit and a 14-day trial extension while we complete the investigation and ensure your tests can run reliably. Looping in Sean (sales lead) and Rachel (billing/security) to help approve and process.

Can you confirm the HubSpot company ID (or reply with the best billing contact)? I'll prepare the proposed credit amount and send a formal note no later than today EOD PT.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation cluster regression — goodwill credit request (DataForge, DF-2026-91)

Sean / Rachel — forwarding DataForge's note. Trial customer hit a latency/downtime regression during day 1 of their evaluation. They want: (1) goodwill credit covering affected usage window (overnight run) and (2) a 14-day trial extension.

Quick facts:
- Account: DataForge (HubSpot ID: 98765)
- Trial started: 2026-10-17 20:00 UTC (approx)
- Impact window: 2026-10-17 22:35–23:15 UTC (customer traces show retries/timeouts)
- Attachments: incident-slo-report-20261017.pdf, sla-uptime-chart.png (included)

Proposed commercial response for approval: $2,500 credit (covers token/compute costs for the affected run) + 14-day trial extension. I picked $2.5k as a conservative goodwill amount that offsets their test cost without pre-committing a large precedent.

If you can approve or propose an alternate amount I'll draft the response and the short amendment (DocuSign) to reflect the extension + credit.

Thanks,
Priya
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation cluster regression — goodwill credit request (DataForge, DF-2026-91)

Priya — thanks for the context. I'm fine with the $2.5k credit for this one-off eval impact. Please also add a 30-day trial extension instead of 14 — this is an enterprise account with probable expansion and a slightly longer window reduces churn risk.

Rachel — please confirm the accounting flow (credit memo vs invoice adjustment) and whether we need an amendment DocuSign. If legal/billing prefers, we can issue a promo credit code instead.

If all good, Priya, send the external message and the amendment link. Aim to keep the customer timeline short and get confirmation today.

— Sean
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Anna Bergström <anna@dataforge.ai>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai, support@dataforge.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Goodwill credit and trial extension for DataForge (DF-2026-91)

Hi Anna — again, I'm really sorry for the disruption you saw on 2026-10-17. We completed a preliminary infra review and identified a scheduling regression in the US-west evaluation pool that caused elevated queue times for short bursts; the fix is deployed and we are monitoring.

To make this right we will:
- Issue a one-time goodwill credit of $2,500 against your account (visible as a credit memo).
- Extend your trial by 30 days (new trial expiry: 2026-11-16).

I've attached a short incident summary and uptime chart for your records. If you prefer a promo code instead of a credit memo we can generate that. For the extension/administrative change we'll send a brief one-page amendment via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC123 (placeholder).

Please reply to confirm this works for you and share the best billing contact if different from yourself. We'll aim to get the credit applied within two business days once you confirm.

Thanks for your patience — we value DataForge and hope this helps restore confidence for your demo.

Warmly,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
T: +1-415-555-0192

Attachments: incident-slo-report-20261017.pdf, sla-uptime-chart.png
From: Anna Bergström <anna@dataforge.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: support@dataforge.ai
Date: 2026-10-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Goodwill credit and trial extension for DataForge (DF-2026-91)

Hi Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the explanation. The proposed $2.5k credit + 30-day extension sounds good. Please send the DocuSign amendment to our procurement lead (procurement@dataforge.ai) and apply the credit memo to account DF-2026-91.

Appreciate the transparency — we'll rerun our demo next week and share any follow-ups.

Best,
Anna
Head of Platform, DataForge
